versos.texto_bv: e os suportou por cerca de quarenta anos no deserto,
versos.traducao_literal: e, por um tempo de quarenta anos, suportou os modos deles no deserto,
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Objeto omitido: a BV diz "os suportou" sem especificar o que suportou. O grego ἐτροποφόρησεν tem objeto explícito (τοὺς τρόπους αὐτῶν — "os modos/costumes deles"). — evidência: NTLH: "aguentou aquela gente"; ARA: "suportou-lhes os maus costumes"; NVIPT: "os aturou". A traducao_literal registra "suportou os modos deles". Correção exigiria adicionar conteúdo semântico ausente do texto publicado.

kjv.texto: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

vizinhos.17: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
vizinhos.19: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

web.texto: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

vizinhos.17: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
vizinhos.19: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.

versos.texto_bv: por cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos. Depois disso, deu-lhes juízes até o profeta Samuel.
versos.traducao_literal: como em quatrocentos e cinquenta anos. E depois destas coisas, deu juízes até Samuel, profeta.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Variante textual: a BV anexa "por cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos" ao v. 20 (referindo-se ao período dos juízes), seguindo uma tradição manuscrita. A ARA o anexa ao v. 19 (referindo-se à herança/conquista). — evidência: ARA v.19: "deu-lhes o território delas por herança durante cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos"; ARA v.20 omite a frase. NTLH e NVIPT seguem a mesma divisão da BV. Decisão sobre a alocação do período exige arbitragem textual que ultrapassa revisão de forma.

kjv.texto: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

vizinhos.19: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
vizinhos.21: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

web.texto: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

vizinhos.19: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.
vizinhos.21: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
